fields.name: service_date
fields.description: Service date. References GTFS indirectly via calendars.txt and calendar_dates.txt

fields.name: trip_stop_sequence
fields.title: Positive integer referencing stop_visits.trip_stop_sequence
fields.description: The actual order of stops visited within a performed trip, matching the stop_visits row the prediction is for.

fields.name: producer
fields.title: Identifier of the prediction source
fields.description: Identifies the system that made the prediction, for example a GTFS-realtime TripUpdates feed. Lets one data package compare several prediction sources for the same stop visits.

fields.name: prediction_timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp at which the prediction was made (for GTFS-realtime, TripUpdate.timestamp or else FeedHeader.timestamp). A row only appears when a predicted time changes, and it holds until the next row with the same service_date, trip_id_performed, trip_stop_sequence and producer. A row with both predicted_arrival_time and predicted_departure_time empty withdraws the prediction: the producer stopped predicting the stop before it was visited, or the recording has a gap, and the previous row no longer holds.

fields.name: trip_id_scheduled
fields.title: ID referencing GTFS trips.trip_id
fields.description: Identifies the scheduled trip associated with the trip performed. References GTFS

fields.name: scheduled_stop_sequence
fields.title: positive integer referencing GTFS stop_times.stop_sequence
fields.description: Scheduled order of the stop within trip_id_scheduled. With service_date and trip_id_scheduled it identifies the stop without stop_visits, so predictions can be matched to stop visits from another source. References GTFS

fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.title: ID referencing vehicles.vehicle_id
fields.description: Identifies the vehicle the prediction was made for.

fields.name: predicted_arrival_time
fields.description: Predicted timestamp at which the vehicle arrives at the stop. Empty when the row withdraws the prediction (see prediction_timestamp).

fields.name: predicted_departure_time
fields.description: Predicted timestamp at which the vehicle departs the stop. Empty when the row withdraws the prediction (see prediction_timestamp).

fields.name: arrival_uncertainty
fields.description: Expected error of predicted_arrival_time in seconds, as given by the producer.

fields.name: departure_uncertainty
fields.description: Expected error of predicted_departure_time in seconds, as given by the producer.

fields.name: schedule_relationship
fields.description: Indicates the predicted status of the stop.

name: stop_time_predictions
description: Predicted arrival and departure times by trip and stop for each service date, recorded each time a producer changes its prediction.
